name: Sense CMS Bluesky Publisher
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Publishes reviewed Sense CMS posts to connected Bluesky accounts through AT Protocol OAuth.

changelog.summary: Restore expired-token refresh and validate post payloads before consuming refresh credentials.
Close the OAuth window after return even when the provider has isolated it from the opener.
Align versioned administration assets with the PDS-cluster compatibility release.
Support Bluesky-operated PDS clusters while retaining strict endpoint validation.
Connect multiple Bluesky accounts with AT Protocol OAuth and publish reviewed website-card posts.
